finalText:
Build's clean: 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump changing shapes:
1. `src/core/options.js:6` — read `options.retries` but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — strict check threw on `undefined`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as `false` (disabled).

The other ~950 lines were deprecation/dedupe noise, not errors — left alone.
